columns.name: id
columns.dc:description: ID of the national party as listed in the EP corporate bodies list

columns.name: label
columns.dc:description: The official name of the party

columns.name: short_label
columns.dc:description: The short label/abbreviation of the party

columns.name: start_date
columns.dc:description: When the party was founded (if founded during a term), otherwise start of the relevant term.

columns.name: end_date
columns.dc:description: When the party ceased to exist or the relevant term ended. Empty if ongoing.

columns.name: country_code
columns.dc:description: Country code from the home country of the party.
